Name: Animal Statues for Alternative Textxures (AT)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

I always loved that chicken statue so much, but was missing the same love for all the other animals.

I made these statues myself, and then Noav7 came in with a [i]gorgeous[/i] retexture of my original designs. ♥

﻿Wooden statues for all the animals on small or big bas﻿es depending on their size + gold recolours.

If you would rather add all the statues as separate items using Custom Furniture, download [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12426]this version[/url][/b].

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

Just place the Chicken or Bear Statue and recolour it using the [b][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url]﻿[/b], or use the [b][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Brush-Tool]Paint Brush[/url]﻿[/b] to copy / paste textures.
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b]-[/b]specific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_credits.png[/img]
﻿
Most of the sprites are originally from the game, edited by [b]lydocia[/b], including even better art by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/124850573?tab=user+files]Noav7[/url][/b].
Assets edited and packaged for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][/b].
Please do not re-use or re-share anywhere without my permission
